children: has reached an agreement with unions representing workers at its Loulo-Gounkoto gold mining operation in western Mali, Bloomberg News reported on Sunday, citing Abdoulaye Coulibaly, a member of Mali’s National Workers’ Union or UNTM.
“The strike threat has been resolved,” Coulibaly said, and there’s an agreement involving workers at Food & Events Africa, Somilo SA and Gounkoto SA, the report added.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report.
